views.createSql:
CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT sr.entryId, sr.grade, sr.intervalDays, sr.easeFactor, sr.nextReviewAt,
           sr.reviewedAt AS lastReviewedAt
    FROM srs_review sr
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT entryId, MAX(reviewedAt) AS maxReviewedAt
        FROM srs_review
        GROUP BY entryId
    ) latest ON sr.entryId = latest.entryId AND sr.reviewedAt = latest.maxReviewedAt
CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT quizId, MAX(score) AS masteryScore FROM quiz_attempts GROUP BY quizId
